description: Several steps in order in one call, e.g. fill a form's fields and submit it; each gets the same checks as its own tool. Stops at the first that fails, after one that moves the page to another address (later refs would belong to the old page), and after one that raised a dialog, opened a new tab, had a server write refused or unanswered, left the page still loading, or left a check or sign-in on the page. Returns a line per step with what each earlier step did that must not be lost (dialogs, tab, refused writes, invalid fields, choices, field read-back), then the evidence and visible screen after the last one run (snapshot:false: the evidence only).

action.description: click, select, type take ref; type: text (submit: Enter after); select: values; press: key; scroll: direction; wait: seconds

ref.description: From the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12" or "f1e3"

snapshot.description: Default true; false: evidence and notes only, as in browser_click.

name: browser_actions
title: Several actions in one call
